settings.title: Options
settings.engineModeDescription: GPU mode requires a PC with a discrete GPU.
settings.gpuUnavailable: GPU mode is unavailable because no supported GPU was found.
settings.samplingRateDescription: Change the sampling rate used for playback and export. A higher sampling rate does not improve audio quality.
settings.presetDescription: Enable presets to save and apply parameter settings.
settings.applyDefaultPreset: Apply default preset when changing style
settings.applyDefaultPresetDescription: Automatically apply the default preset when changing the speaker or style.
settings.inheritParametersDescription: Use current parameters such as speech speed when adding a text field.
settings.followPlaybackDescription: Choose how the detailed adjustment pane scrolls during playback.
settings.continuousDescription: Keep the current playback position centered.
settings.pageDescription: Scroll when the current playback position is outside the visible area.
settings.autoSplitDescription: Choose where pasted text is split.
settings.memoDescription: Write notes in text by enclosing them in [].
settings.restoreHintsDescription: Show every hint you previously hid again.
settings.fixedExportDescription: Specify the export folder in advance.
settings.fileNamePatternDescription: Customize the file name pattern used for export.
settings.avoidOverwriteDescription: When a file with the same name exists, save it with a sequence number.
settings.encodingDescription: Choose the encoding used when exporting text files.
settings.exportTextDescription: Export the text as a TXT file when exporting audio.
settings.exportLabDescription: Export a LAB file for lip sync when exporting audio.
settings.showLineNumbersDescription: Show line numbers on the left side of text fields.
settings.showAddButtonDescription: When off, the add text button in the bottom right is hidden. (Text fields can still be added with Shift + Enter)
settings.multiEngineDescription: Enable multiple VOICEVOX API compatible speech synthesis engines.
settings.stereoAudioDescription: Convert audio data from mono to stereo before playback and saving.
settings.retainAdjustmentsDescription: Retain adjustment results within the same accent phrase when text is changed.
settings.allowDataCollectionDescription: When enabled, data such as UI usage statistics will be sent to help improve AivisSpeech. Text and audio data are not sent.
settings.dataCollectionDisabledMessage: AivisSpeech must be restarted to completely disable software usage data collection.

audioInfo.reregisterAll: Reregister preset and reapply to all text fields with this preset

param.intonationScaleTooltip:
Adjust emotion expression strength of selected speaker style
Stronger = more emotion matching the style
Too strong may cause unnatural monotone voice (varies by speaker/style)
(Not adjustable for Normal style as appropriate emotion is auto-selected)
param.tempoDynamicsScaleTooltip:
Adjust tempo variation strength
Stronger = more natural rubato-like speech
param.pitchScaleTooltip:
Adjust voice pitch
Changing from 0.00 degrades audio quality
param.prePhonemeLengthTooltip: Adjust silence at start of audio
param.postPhonemeLengthTooltip: Adjust silence at end of audio

dictionaryManage.title: Pronunciation & Accent Dictionary
dictionaryManage.emptyDescription: Add words you want to register from the Add button in the upper right of the screen.

dictionaryEditWord.yomiError: Only hiragana and katakana can be used for reading.
dictionaryEditWord.description1: The TTS engine converts text internally to make it easier to read aloud.
dictionaryEditWord.description2: During this conversion, English words are converted to katakana, and some dates, symbols, and units are converted to Japanese readings.
dictionaryEditWord.description3: The user dictionary is applied to the converted text, so if the original word contains dates, symbols, or units, it may not be applied as intended.
dictionaryEditWord.partOfSpeechDescription: Select the part of speech for the word you are registering. Setting it appropriately improves the accuracy of the user dictionary.
dictionaryEditWord.accentAdjustDescription: To allow adjustment considering the accent at the end of the word, "ga" is automatically inserted.
dictionaryEditWord.priorityDescription: If the word is not reflected even after registering it, try gradually increasing the word priority.
